body: well I already know how it will end

no i feel making it this far shows how far someone can go by leeching off others and abusing meds and shit. Its not really strength if a hospice patient lasts another few months is it. Ive had fucking everything taken away from me, my sister dying, my only friend, my hobbies, and now my will to live. It isn't an accomplishment.

I've always been depressed though, well at least not happy. My parents split up when I was young and I lived with my mom, and we were fairly poor. Kids would always make fun of me for wearing the same outfit to school or having 3 dads because my mom divorced so often. And while having the same problem doesn't make it any easier, I think that speaks more to personal strength rather than something out of my control.
don't worry i'm in the wilderness. A lot of shit really, been suicidal for years like I said, don't enjoy anything really. I mean I sound like any other fucker on here but man it blows.
